coverage.note: First five teaching intervals plus their actual shared final held frame.

displayYawProvenance.policy: Fixed body-relative display rotation; not calibrated camera geometry.
displayYawProvenance.method: Median atan2(-shoulderDeltaZ, shoulderDeltaX) of actual anatomical left-minus-right world shoulder observations.

coordinatePolicy: Raw image and model-estimated world coordinates are preserved. Rendering uses x,-y,-z, hip centering and a fixed initial-stance yaw; no reconstructed travel or foot contact.
provenance: Actual local MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Lite float16 v1 CPU VIDEO inference on SHA-256 verified lossless original 24.mp4 PNGs at exact source frame IDs. One continuous model session. All runtime assets and inputs are local; external requests, including SDK usage logging, are blocked. Newly observed image and world coordinates; original assessment landmarks remain unchanged. Recorded teacher data, not live camera results or calibrated 3D reconstruction.
samplingPolicy: 15 Hz exact-PNG observations plus teaching boundaries, source frames 15 through 465 inclusive. No interpolation, future observations, cross-recording borrowing or synthesized joints.
landmarkCoordinates: landmarks: normalized image x/y and model-relative z; worldLandmarks: model-estimated meters relative to the pose, not calibrated multi-view reconstruction.
presencePolicy: Visibility and presence are preserved when supplied; absent presence is null and remains unknown.
